## StonecropClass.runAction() method

Runs the action for the given doctype and id

**Signature:**

```typescript
runAction(doctype: DoctypeMeta, action: string, id?: string[]): void;
```

## Example 1


```ts

stonecrop.runAction(doctype, 'create')
```
